messages:
tess (eng-ml): quick sync: proposing a refactor of the smoke/probe phase in onboarding. idea: split smoke into Probe-A (tokenization + fingerprint), Probe-B (small replay matrix for kv/cache checks), Probe-C (micro latency sweep). Each probe emits a compact artifact and a pass/fail bit.

noor (eng-platform): makes sense. platform needs a single run_id and immutable probe ids. also want a tiny admission response: {ready_for_routing, stage, run_id, rollback_token}.

dave (eng-sre): operational constraints: all probes must be low-priority and never use production GPU pools. add per-tenant token budgets and global probe concurrency limits. auto-abort if probe queue depth > 80.

maya (product): customers want clarity: show "probe passed" vs "probe failed" and an ETA for next probe. surface repro link and cost estimate.

anil (qa): QA asks for reproducibility: probes must include a provenance manifest (uris + sha256) and a tiny seedset for each probe. include a reproduce.sh in the artifact. For Probe-B (kv), include a short token stream and expected logits-checksum.

tess (eng-ml): example probe descriptor snippet (compact):
```json
{"model_id":"redwood/atlas-2b","commit":"cafebabe","probes":["A","B","C"],"seeds":[13,21,34],"provenance":"s3://bench/atlas-2b/2026-03-23"}
```

noor (eng-platform): Console changes: add a Probe Timeline with run_id, per-probe metrics (p50,p95,kv_mismatch_count,cost_estimate), and a manual rollback button that redeems rollback_token. also record audit events.

dave (eng-sre): alerts: probe B kv_mismatch_rate > 0 -> mark runtime variant as unsafe; repeated false positives -> create SRE ticket. Probe-C p95 > 2x baseline for 10m -> page oncall.

anil (qa): decision flow: auto-pass if thresholds met; borderline -> create a triage job with diffs and attach reproduce.sh. make sure seeds + manifest are included so QA can rerun locally.

maya (product): include expected timings: Probe-A <1m, Probe-B ~5-15m, Probe-C ~20-45m. show these in UI and docs so customers know typical availability.

ci-bot: queued: onboard/probe-refactor/4278901234 (A+B+C)

tess (eng-ml): next steps: I'll write an RFC with the probe state machine, descriptor fields, metric names, and runbook. owners: tess (design), noor (api/console), anil (QA), dave (SRE). aim to post draft by EOD.

noor (eng-platform): will sketch minimal status API and a compact admission response.

dave (eng-sre): I'll add probe throttle rules and alerting thresholds to SRE playbook.

anil (qa): will define the reproducible seed sets and the format for provenance manifests.

tess (eng-ml): thanks team. will ping when RFC is live.
